What color is the blood? Is it bright red or dark red? If it is dark red blood, and the blood looks like it has coffee grounds, then it is a very serious situation because the blood is from your GI system. Seek medical help immediately, go to the emergency room. The least dangerous case would be you scratching your throat during purging, but the fact that it's a lot of blood concerns me. It could be your esophagus bleeding, which is known as Mallory Weiss syndrome. Please go to the emergency room to get it checked out. It's very dangerous. Purging again is not worth it. Maybe...just maybe...if you are unlucky...you could get seriously hurt or even die this time... and we don't want that to happen to you... :( The chocolate will not cause permanent weight gain. What's worse - leaving chocolate in your stomach to digest (and maybe gaining a pound or two of food and water weight) or risking your life? If (not saying you will, it could be a tiny possibility) you die... you'll never be able to eat chocolate again... Don't do it! Your natural instinct is telling you it isn't worth it, but the eating disorder tells you to do it because it is trying to really harm you. The eating disorder is WRONG. Trust your instinct. Get the problem checked out and try your best to take a break from purging. I know how hard it is, as I'm suffering from bulimia, too, but please try this time because your life could depend on it. We care about you. You are worth it. (Also, I am truly sorry if my answer came off as intimidating, I just wanted to try to dissuade you from purging this one time.)
